user: Is the deadline the same for every reason code?
answer:
No, each reason code has its own window, counted in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

For goods_not_received, the 90 days run from the transaction date. Both TechMart Online payments (TX-0401 on 20 July 2026 and TX-0402 on 14 July 2026) fall inside that window based on the dates in your account. The window is only one condition, though. The eligibility check is what confirms whether a specific transaction can be disputed, so I will run it again once you tell me which transaction you want to dispute.
